card.text: TOI-700 d was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-700 d"
sources.quote: TOI-700 d is a dense, rocky, near-Earth-sized exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of the red dwarf TOI-700.

introduction.text: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-700. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-700 d"
sources.quote: It is located roughly 101.4 light-years (31.1 pc) away from Earth in the constellation of Dorado and is the outermost of four confirmed exoplanets around its star.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
